title: Angel Trax/AngelTrax Stop-Arm Camera Program and Related Agreements

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Maryland Public Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

I request electronic copies of existing public records concerning Harford County Public Schools’ school-bus stop-arm camera and enforcement program involving IVS, Inc., doing business as Angel Trax/AngelTrax. Please search records maintained by the Board of Education of Harford County, HCPS departments, and the Office of General Counsel.

Date range: January 1, 2017 through the date of your search.

Please provide the following records:

Procurement and contract records
Solicitations, RFPs, RFQs, IFBs, invitations, specifications, addenda, questions and answers, vendor proposals, bid tabulations, evaluation materials, scoring, award recommendations, and Board approvals concerning Angel Trax/AngelTrax or IVS, Inc.
The executed contract or contracts, exhibits, statements of work, pricing schedules, purchase orders, amendments, renewals, extensions, options, termination notices, and records sufficient to show the current contract term and scope.
Invoices, payment records, credits, rebates, discounts, or other compensation or consideration exchanged with the vendor, including records concerning any “no-cost” or revenue-sharing arrangement.
MOUs, MOAs, ILAs, and interagency agreements
Any memorandum of understanding, memorandum of agreement, interlocal agreement, interagency agreement, cooperative agreement, data-sharing agreement, or similar document involving HCPS, the Board of Education, the Harford County Sheriff’s Office, Harford County Government, another law-enforcement agency, or any other public entity in connection with the program.
Please include agreements with Angel Trax/AngelTrax or IVS, Inc. and all amendments, exhibits, attachments, renewals, and related approval records.
Please include provisions addressing roles and responsibilities, equipment ownership, installation and maintenance, video or photograph access, citation review and approval, fine or revenue distribution, indemnification, insurance, records retention, data security, privacy, and termination.
Program implementation and operating records
Policies, procedures, standard operating procedures, training materials, user guides, forms, review criteria, approval workflows, chain-of-custody procedures, evidence-retention schedules, access controls, audit procedures, and records sufficient to identify how stop-arm violation footage is reviewed and referred for enforcement.
Records sufficient to show the number of buses equipped, installation dates, equipment or service descriptions, program launch or pilot dates, and the current status of the program.
Program performance and financial records
Reports, dashboards, evaluations, audits, statistics, or other existing records concerning violations captured, referrals, citations issued, dismissals, collections, appeals, complaints, program costs, savings, revenue, or distributions associated with the stop-arm program.
Records concerning grants, appropriations, budget approvals, or other funding for the program.
Substantive communications and issue records

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 calendar days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Jon Smith
